title: Can you solve the prisoner hat riddle? - Alex Gendler
blurb: Ten prisoners, ten hats and one clever strategy: pause before the reveal and see if your family can crack it first.

title: Can you solve the bridge riddle? - Alex Gendler
blurb: Four people, one lantern, a rickety bridge and zombies closing in. A timing puzzle that rewards thinking a few moves ahead.

title: Can you solve "Einstein's Riddle"? - Dan Van der Vieren
blurb: A famous logic grid puzzle about houses, pets and drinks. Grab paper, follow the clues and track down the missing fish.

title: Can you solve the river crossing riddle? - Lisa Winer
blurb: A twist on the classic river crossing puzzle where every boat trip counts. Great for solving together as a group.

title: Backyard Squirrel Maze 1.0- Ninja Warrior Course
blurb: A former NASA engineer builds an eight-stage obstacle course to outwit bird-feeder thieves, and the squirrels keep surprising him.

title: World's Largest Jello Pool- Can you swim in Jello?
blurb: What happens when you fill an entire pool with jello? Big logistics, wobbly physics and an answer to a question every kid has asked.

title: Mystery of Prince Rupert's Drop at 130,000 fps - Smarter Every Day 86
blurb: A glass droplet that shrugs off hammer blows yet bursts when you snip its tail, explained with stunning ultra-slow-motion footage.

title: The Immune System Explained I – Bacteria Infection
blurb: Colourful animation turns a scraped finger into an epic battle, showing how your body's defenders team up against invading bacteria.

title: THE AMAZING TRIPLE SPIRAL (15,000 DOMINOES)
blurb: Fifteen thousand dominoes topple into three interlocking spirals. Hypnotic proof of what patience and careful planning can build.

title: Wintergatan - Marble Machine (music instrument using 2000 marbles)
blurb: A hand-cranked wooden machine drops two thousand steel marbles onto real instruments to play an entire song. Engineering meets music.

title: OK Go - This Too Shall Pass - Rube Goldberg Machine - Official Video
blurb: A warehouse-sized chain reaction of dominoes, toy cars and falling pianos, timed perfectly to the beat in one continuous take.

title: The Page Turner | Rube Goldberg | Joseph's Machines
blurb: A gloriously overcomplicated contraption built from household odds and ends, all to turn a single page of a book.

title: Giant Nerf Trick Shots | Dude Perfect
blurb: Oversized foam blasters and absurd targets. A high-energy trick shot reel that will have kids trying their own backyard versions.

title: Water Bottle Flip 2 | Dude Perfect
blurb: The viral bottle flip craze pushed to ridiculous extremes: moving targets, long-distance landings and plenty of celebration.

title: After 34 Years, Someone Finally Beat Tetris
blurb: How a 13-year-old became the first player ever to 'beat' classic Tetris, and the wild techniques that made it possible.

title: The Best Games from GMTK Game Jam 2022
blurb: A tour of inventive tiny games built in just 48 hours. A fun peek at how game designers turn one idea into play.
